notes: Bug: Floating sidebar toggle buttons were invisible after sidebar collapse. Root cause: collapsed buttons were positioned at left: 0 and right: 0, flush with the viewport edge. With a 40px circular button, right: 0 clips the right half off-screen, and left: 0 clips the left half. Fix: changed collapsed positions to left: 8px and right: 8px, giving an 8px offset that keeps the full button visible and clickable. Added 2 unit tests (FST-CSS-12, FST-CSS-13) verifying offset > 0. Updated 2 E2E test assertions from '0px' to '8px'. Full suite: 0 failures.
